# Townie List
> Community directories of license-checked local pros, region by region. Live region: Eugene & Springfield, Oregon - 10 licensed trades plus independent restaurants, coffee shops, food trucks, auto repair shops and a local events calendar.
> Listings are free; ratings come from Google and are checked monthly; licenses are verified against Oregon CCB records.
